body: Just heard about the changes at your company. That's a rough thing to get hit with, and it says nothing about you.
You're the person every team I've been on wished it had: the one who stays calm at 2 a.m. and makes everyone around them better.
Whenever you're ready, I'd love to send a note to a couple of folks I know who are hiring. And dinner's on me this Friday: biryani at that place near the old office?
offer: warm introductions when he's ready; dinner Friday

light_moment.lead: And because I know you'll appreciate it: Frank Costanza's "Serenity now!" never gets old.
light_moment.title: Seinfeld, "The Serenity Now" (season 9, episode 3), on your streaming service
